scope: Actual star_4-layer.pmmotor version 0 and its saved drive settings. Geometric-edge resistance, SciPy branch currents and 3D trace/via quadrature reconstructed independently. Connectivity and arc tessellation still come from Rust; Magpylib/magba cuboid agreement is analytical equivalence, not material validation.
force_metric_note: Nine fixed phase-A excitation positions, not the commutated mean thrust or travel-ripple metric from earlier studies.
qualification_limits: No backplane or housing material in this oracle
No waveform, hardware or finite moving housing qualification
